entities.summary: Hiroaki Ishiura is a Japanese racing driver from Tokyo. He currently drives in the Super GT series for Rookie Racing. He was the 2015 and 2017 Super Formula champion, and is known as a fast and strong driver. Hiroaki Ishiura was a architects & engineers from Tokyo (b. 1981-04-23, Tokyo).
